release_read.basis: Q4 revenue guide $730-750m (midpoint $740m) is about 13% above the ~$656m bar the hunt named, with non-GAAP GM guided flat at ~72% (the feared step-down below 72% did not come) and Q4 EPS guide $1.62-1.66; Q3 beat too ($584.9m vs ~$551m, non-GAAP EPS $1.32 vs ~$1.19). A guide this far above the bar into a 38% run-down justifies roughly the implied move up, discounted for a name that sold its last three beats.

release.headline: Astera Labs reports Q3 2026 results: record revenue $584.9m, up 49% QoQ and 154% YoY
